mapper.sql: BIN_TO_UUID(id) AS id, slug, visibility, status, code_mode, title, statement_markdown, input_description_markdown, output_description_markdown, constraints_markdown, hint_markdown, difficulty, CAST(tags_json AS CHAR) AS tags_json, test_data_location, test_data_updated_at, created_at, updated_at, published_at, row_version

where.if: (slug LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ESCAPE '\\' OR title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ESCAPE '\\')

mapper.select: SELECT FROM problem WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id})
SELECT FROM problem WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT language_id, display_order, starter_code FROM problem_language WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}) ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem (id, slug, visibility, status, code_mode, title, statement_markdown, input_description_markdown, output_description_markdown, constraints_markdown, hint_markdown, difficulty, tags_json, checker_type, test_data_location, test_data_updated_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, published_at, row_version) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{problem.id}), #{problem.slug}, #{problem.visibility}, #{problem.status}, #{problem.codeMode}, #{problem.title}, #{problem.statementMarkdown}, #{problem.inputDescriptionMarkdown}, #{problem.outputDescriptionMarkdown}, #{problem.constraintsMarkdown}, #{problem.hintMarkdown}, #{problem.difficulty}, #{problem.tagsJson}, 'DEFAULT', #{problem.testDataLocation}, #{problem.testDataUpdatedAt}, UUID_TO_BIN(#{createdBy}), #{problem.createdAt}, #{problem.updatedAt}, #{problem.publishedAt}, #{problem.rowVersion})

INSERT INTO problem_sample (id, problem_id, ordinal, input_text, expected_output_text, explanation_markdown) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}), #{ordinal}, #{inputText}, #{expectedOutputText}, #{explanationMarkdown})
INSERT INTO problem_language (problem_id, language_id, display_order, starter_code, judge_template) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}), #{languageId}, #{displayOrder}, #{starterCode}, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE problem SET slug = #{problem.slug}, title = #{problem.title}, statement_markdown = #{problem.statementMarkdown}, input_description_markdown = #{problem.inputDescriptionMarkdown}, output_description_markdown = #{problem.outputDescriptionMarkdown}, constraints_markdown = #{problem.constraintsMarkdown}, hint_markdown = #{problem.hintMarkdown}, difficulty = #{problem.difficulty}, tags_json = #{problem.tagsJson}, updated_at = #{problem.updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problem.id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET visibility = 'PRIVATE', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE problem SET test_data_location = #{location}, test_data_updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM problem_sample WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId})
DELETE FROM problem_language WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId})
DELETE FROM problem_audit_event WHERE problem_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId})
DELETE FROM problem WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND published_at IS NULL AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_audit_event (id, problem_id, actor_user_id, action, trace_id, detail_json, created_at) VALUES (UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{problemId}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{actorUserId}), #{action}, #{traceId}, #{detailJson}, #{createdAt})
